Finding friends takes coordination. A survey of fifteen hundred adult
festival-goers found forty-four percent used group chats, forty-three
percent calls, and forty percent live location.
SafeNight brings that into one place. See your group, their shared
locations, and a timeline of everyone's check-ins.
Invite friends, ask someone to come to you, or open driver concerns
and venue reports.
Group messages keep everyone updated when someone misses a check-in
or asks for help.
